fieldHints.label: App name
fieldHints.text: Shown under the icon on the home screen.

fieldHints.label: Package name
fieldHints.text: The app\'s unique id. Keep it the same so a new export installs as an update — changing it makes a separate app.

fieldHints.label: Version
fieldHints.text: Shown in Android settings (e.g. 1.0, 1.1). The build number goes up automatically.

fieldHints.label: App icon
fieldHints.text: A square image works best.

fieldHints.label: Faces forward
fieldHints.text: Untick if it walks backwards

fieldHints.text: The game is shown through this camera

fieldHints.label: Range
fieldHints.text: 0 = unlimited

fieldHints.text: Detects touches but things pass through (coins, zones)

fieldHints.label: 3D sound

fieldHints.text: Overlay fills the screen. World Space puts the UI where this object is, in the scene.

fieldHints.label: Face the camera
fieldHints.text: On: a name tag or health bar that stays the same size on screen. Off: a flat surface standing in the scene, which turns with the object and shrinks with distance.

fieldHints.label: Size (px)
fieldHints.text: The box the elements inside anchor to, in reference px.

fieldHints.label: Pixels per metre
fieldHints.text: At 100, a 200 px canvas is 2 metres wide.

fieldHints.label: Height offset (m)
fieldHints.text: How far above the object’s top the canvas floats.

fieldHints.label: Sort order
fieldHints.text: Higher canvases are drawn over lower ones.

fieldHints.label: Canvas
fieldHints.text: The Canvas above this element decides where it is drawn. Select it to change that.
c.kind === 'slider' ? 'Optional. {value}, {min}, {max} and {percent} are replaced, e.g. "HP {value}/{max}"' : undefined

fieldHints.label: Raycast target

fieldHints.label: Border (px)

c.kind === 'image' ? 'Multiplies the picture, as Unity\'s Image colour does. White leaves it alone.' : undefined

fieldHints.label: Wrap
fieldHints.text: Fold long text inside the rect instead of running past it

fieldHints.label: Handle
fieldHints.text: A knob the player can drag while Interactable is on. Off = a bar that only shows a value.

fieldHints.label: Interactable
fieldHints.text: Off = greyed out and deaf to input

fieldHints.label: Mask
fieldHints.text: Clips the children to this element, like Unity’s Mask. Rectangle uses its box and corner radius; Image uses the opaque parts of a picture.

fieldHints.label: Blend mode
fieldHints.text: How this element mixes with the UI behind it. The 3D view is drawn on its own layer below, so blending stops at the UI.

fieldHints.label: Anchors
fieldHints.text: Where in the parent the element sticks. A stretched row or column makes it grow with the parent.

fieldHints.label: Also set
fieldHints.text: What a preset changes besides the anchors (Unity\'s Shift and Alt clicks)

fieldHints.label: Pivot
fieldHints.text: 0,0 is the bottom-left corner, 1,1 the top-right. Rotation and scale turn around it.

fieldHints.label: Width fits content
fieldHints.text: Unity\'s Content Size Fitter: the text or picture decides this axis

fieldHints.label: Kind
fieldHints.text: Place the children in a row, a column or a grid instead of by their own anchors

fieldHints.label: Padding
fieldHints.text: Inside edges: X left and right, Y top and bottom

fieldHints.label: Child controls size

fieldHints.label: Sort order

behaviorParamHelp.driver: manual = you drive it with events or scripts (Drive car); ai = drives itself along Path
behaviorParamHelp.reverseSpeed: Top speed in reverse (m/s). 0 = 60% of Speed
behaviorParamHelp.steerRate: How fast the wheels turn toward full lock (degrees per second). 0 = default
behaviorParamHelp.steerAtTopSpeed: Percent of full steering lock kept at top speed (100 = same at any speed)
behaviorParamHelp.topSpeedEase: Percent of top speed over which the engine fades out (0 = hard cap, can make the body pitch)
behaviorParamHelp.suspensionStiffness: Spring strength multiplier (higher = stiffer, less dive when braking)
behaviorParamHelp.suspensionDamping: Spring damping multiplier (higher = settles faster, less bounce)
behaviorParamHelp.seat: Where the rider sits, in the vehicle's own axes: 'x, y, z'
behaviorParamHelp.autoSeat: Enter vehicle seats the rider here (rides along, stops walking) and Exit vehicle puts it down beside. Off = you do it with Attach to / Detach
behaviorParamHelp.autoCamera: Enter vehicle makes the camera follow this vehicle (and back on Exit). Off = use Set camera target
behaviorParamHelp.path: Waypoint objects forming the racing line, e.g. #waypoint

colliderShapeHints.auto: Models follow their real shape (still objects: exact; moving objects: convex parts)
colliderShapeHints.convex: One shrink-wrapped hull around the model. Fast; fills in gaps and dents
colliderShapeHints.mesh: Follows every triangle. Best for still scenery like trees, arches and ramps
